verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֖ם מוֹעֲדָֽי׃ מוֹעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ תִּקְרְא֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם קֹ֑דֶשׁ מִקְרָאֵ֣י
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem ’êl·leh hêm mō·w·‘ă·ḏāy mō·w·‘ă·ḏê Yah·weh ’ă·šer- tiq·rə·’ū ’ō·ṯām qō·ḏeš miq·rā·’ê
verses.literal: Speak to the Israelites . . . and say to them These are My appointed feasts the feasts of the LORD that you are to proclaim - as sacred assemblies

verses.original: שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִים֮ מְלָאכָה֒ תֵּעָשֶׂ֣ה הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י וּבַיּ֣וֹם שַׁבַּ֤ת שַׁבָּתוֹן֙ קֹ֔דֶשׁ מִקְרָא־ לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ כָּל־ מְלָאכָ֖ה בְּכֹ֖ל מֽוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃פ הִוא֙ שַׁבָּ֥ת לַֽיהוָ֔ה
verses.transliteration: šê·šeṯ yā·mîm mə·lā·ḵāh tê·‘ā·śeh haš·šə·ḇî·‘î ū·ḇay·yō·wm šab·baṯ šab·bā·ṯō·wn qō·ḏeš miq·rā- lō ṯa·‘ă·śū kāl- mə·lā·ḵāh bə·ḵōl mō·wō·šə·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem hî šab·bāṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: For six days work may be done but the seventh day is a Sabbath of complete rest a day of sacred assembly You must not do any work wherever you live it is a Sabbath to the LORD

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה יְהוָ֔ה מוֹעֲדֵ֣י קֹ֑דֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־ מִקְרָאֵ֖י תִּקְרְא֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם בְּמוֹעֲדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh Yah·weh mō·w·‘ă·ḏê qō·ḏeš ’ă·šer- miq·rā·’ê tiq·rə·’ū ’ō·ṯām bə·mō·w·‘ă·ḏām
verses.literal: These are the LORD’s appointed feasts the sacred - assemblies you are to proclaim - at their appointed times

verses.original: פֶּ֖סַח לַיהוָֽה׃ בֵּ֣ין הָעַרְבָּ֑יִם בְּאַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר לַחֹ֖דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ
verses.transliteration: pe·saḥ Yah·weh bên hā·‘ar·bā·yim bə·’ar·bā·‘āh ‘ā·śār la·ḥō·ḏeš hā·ri·šō·wn ba·ḥō·ḏeš
verses.literal: The Passover to the LORD begins at twilight on the fourteenth . . . day of the first month

verses.original: וּבַחֲמִשָּׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר יוֹם֙ הַזֶּ֔ה לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ חַ֥ג הַמַּצּ֖וֹת לַיהוָ֑ה שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃ מַצּ֥וֹת
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇa·ḥă·miš·šāh ‘ā·śār yō·wm haz·zeh la·ḥō·ḏeš ḥaḡ ham·maṣ·ṣō·wṯ Yah·weh šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm tō·ḵê·lū maṣ·ṣō·wṯ
verses.literal: On the fifteenth . . . day of the same month [begins] the Feast of Unleavened Bread to the LORD For seven days you must eat unleavened bread

verses.original: הָֽרִאשׁ֔וֹן בַּיּוֹם֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם קֹ֖דֶשׁ מִקְרָא־ לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃ כָּל־ עֲבֹדָ֖ה מְלֶ֥אכֶת
verses.transliteration: hā·ri·šō·wn bay·yō·wm yih·yeh lā·ḵem qō·ḏeš miq·rā- lō ṯa·‘ă·śū kāl- ‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh mə·le·ḵeṯ
verses.literal: On the first day you are to hold a sacred assembly you are not to do any regular work

verses.original: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֥ם אִשֶּׁ֛ה לַיהוָ֖ה הַשְּׁבִיעִי֙ בַּיּ֤וֹם קֹ֔דֶשׁ מִקְרָא־ לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃פ כָּל־ עֲבֹדָ֖ה מְלֶ֥אכֶת
verses.transliteration: šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm wə·hiq·raḇ·tem ’iš·šeh Yah·weh haš·šə·ḇî·‘î bay·yō·wm qō·ḏeš miq·rā- lō ṯa·‘ă·śū kāl- ‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh mə·le·ḵeṯ
verses.literal: For seven days you are to present a food offering to the LORD On the seventh day there shall be a sacred assembly you must not do any regular work

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ כִּֽי־ תָבֹ֣אוּ אֶל־ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִי֙ נֹתֵ֣ן לָכֶ֔ם וּקְצַרְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־ קְצִירָ֑הּ וַהֲבֵאתֶ֥ם אֶת־ אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵֽן׃ עֹ֛מֶר רֵאשִׁ֥ית קְצִירְכֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā kî- ṯā·ḇō·’ū ’el- ’ă·lê·hem hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer ’ă·nî nō·ṯên lā·ḵem ū·qə·ṣar·tem ’eṯ- qə·ṣî·rāh wa·hă·ḇê·ṯem ’eṯ- ’el- hak·kō·hên ‘ō·mer rê·šîṯ qə·ṣî·rə·ḵem
verses.literal: Speak to the Israelites . . . and say When you enter . . . . . . the land that I am giving you and you reap - its harvest you are to bring - to the priest a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest

verses.original: וְהֵנִ֧יף אֶת־ הָעֹ֛מֶר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לִֽרְצֹנְכֶ֑ם הַכֹּהֵֽן׃ יְנִיפֶ֖נּוּ מִֽמָּחֳרַת֙ הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·nîp̄ ’eṯ- hā·‘ō·mer lip̄·nê Yah·weh lir·ṣō·nə·ḵem hak·kō·hên yə·nî·p̄en·nū mim·mā·ḥo·raṯ haš·šab·bāṯ
verses.literal: And he shall wave - the sheaf before the LORD so that it may be accepted on your behalf the priest is to wave it on the day after the Sabbath

verses.original: בְּי֥וֹם הֲנִֽיפְכֶ֖ם אֶת־ הָעֹ֑מֶר וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֕ם בֶּן־ שְׁנָת֛וֹ כֶּ֣בֶשׂ תָּמִ֧ים לְעֹלָ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·yō·wm hă·nî·p̄ə·ḵem ’eṯ- hā·‘ō·mer wa·‘ă·śî·ṯem ben- šə·nā·ṯōw ke·ḇeś tā·mîm lə·‘ō·lāh Yah·weh
verses.literal: On the day you wave - the sheaf you shall offer a year-old . . . lamb without blemish as a burnt offering to the LORD

verses.original: וּמִנְחָתוֹ֩ שְׁנֵ֨י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֜ים סֹ֣לֶת בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֛מֶן אִשֶּׁ֥ה לַיהוָ֖ה נִיחֹ֑חַ רֵ֣יחַ וְנִסְכֹּ֥ה רְבִיעִ֥ת הַהִֽין׃ יַ֖יִן
verses.transliteration: ū·min·ḥā·ṯōw šə·nê ‘eś·rō·nîm sō·leṯ bə·lū·lāh ḇaš·še·men ’iš·šeh Yah·weh nî·ḥō·aḥ rê·aḥ wə·nis·kōh rə·ḇî·‘iṯ ha·hîn ya·yin
verses.literal: along with its grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah . . . of fine flour mixed with oil a food offering to the LORD a pleasing aroma and its drink offering of a quarter hin of wine

verses.original: לֹ֣א תֹֽאכְל֗וּ וְלֶחֶם֩ וְקָלִ֨י וְכַרְמֶ֜ל עַד־ הַזֶּ֔ה עֶ֙צֶם֙ הַיּ֣וֹם עַ֚ד הֲבִ֣יאֲכֶ֔ם אֶת־ קָרְבַּ֖ן אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם עוֹלָם֙ חֻקַּ֤ת לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם בְּכֹ֖ל מֹשְׁבֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō ṯō·ḵə·lū wə·le·ḥem wə·qā·lî wə·ḵar·mel ‘aḏ- haz·zeh ‘e·ṣem hay·yō·wm ‘aḏ hă·ḇî·’ă·ḵem ’eṯ- qā·rə·ban ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem ‘ō·w·lām ḥuq·qaṯ lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem bə·ḵōl mō·šə·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: You must not eat any bread or roasted or new grain until the very day - you have brought this offering to your God This is to be a permanent statute for the generations to come wherever you live

verses.original: מִמָּחֳרַ֣ת הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת מִיּוֹם֙ הֲבִ֣יאֲכֶ֔ם אֶת־ עֹ֖מֶר הַתְּנוּפָ֑ה וּסְפַרְתֶּ֤ם לָכֶם֙ שֶׁ֥בַע תְּמִימֹ֥ת תִּהְיֶֽינָה׃ שַׁבָּת֖וֹת
verses.transliteration: mim·mā·ḥo·raṯ haš·šab·bāṯ mî·yō·wm hă·ḇî·’ă·ḵem ’eṯ- ‘ō·mer hat·tə·nū·p̄āh ū·sə·p̄ar·tem lā·ḵem še·ḇa‘ tə·mî·mōṯ tih·ye·nāh šab·bā·ṯō·wṯ
verses.literal: From the day after the Sabbath the day you brought - the sheaf of the wave offering you are to count off seven full weeks

verses.original: תִּסְפְּר֖וּ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים י֑וֹם עַ֣ד מִֽמָּחֳרַ֤ת הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔ת הַשַּׁבָּת֙ וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֛ם חֲדָשָׁ֖ה מִנְחָ֥ה לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: tis·pə·rū ḥă·miš·šîm yō·wm ‘aḏ mim·mā·ḥo·raṯ haš·šə·ḇî·‘iṯ haš·šab·bāṯ wə·hiq·raḇ·tem ḥă·ḏā·šāh min·ḥāh Yah·weh
verses.literal: You shall count off fifty days until the day after the seventh Sabbath and then present an offering of new grain to the LORD

verses.original: תָּבִ֣יאּוּ׀ שְׁ֚תַּיִם לֶ֣חֶם מִמּוֹשְׁבֹ֨תֵיכֶ֜ם תְּנוּפָ֗ה שְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֔ים סֹ֣לֶת תִּהְיֶ֔ינָה תֵּאָפֶ֑ינָה חָמֵ֖ץ בִּכּוּרִ֖ים לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: tā·ḇî’·’ū šə·ta·yim le·ḥem mim·mō·wō·šə·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem tə·nū·p̄āh šə·nê ‘eś·rō·nîm sō·leṯ tih·ye·nāh tê·’ā·p̄e·nāh ḥā·mêṣ bik·kū·rîm Yah·weh
verses.literal: Bring two loaves of bread from your dwellings as a wave offering [each made] from two-tenths of an ephah . . . of fine flour . . . baked with leaven as the firstfruits to the LORD

verses.original: עַל־ הַלֶּ֗חֶם וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֣ם שִׁבְעַ֨ת תְּמִימִם֙ כְּבָשִׂ֤ים בְּנֵ֣י שָׁנָ֔ה אֶחָ֖ד וּפַ֧ר בֶּן־ בָּקָ֛ר שְׁנָ֑יִם וְאֵילִ֣ם יִהְי֤וּ עֹלָה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וּמִנְחָתָם֙ וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֔ם אִשֵּׁ֥ה נִיחֹ֖חַ רֵֽיחַ־ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- hal·le·ḥem wə·hiq·raḇ·tem šiḇ·‘aṯ tə·mî·mim kə·ḇā·śîm bə·nê šā·nāh ’e·ḥāḏ ū·p̄ar ben- bā·qār šə·nā·yim wə·’ê·lim yih·yū ‘ō·lāh Yah·weh ū·min·ḥā·ṯām wə·nis·kê·hem ’iš·šêh nî·ḥō·aḥ rê·aḥ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Along with the bread you are to present seven unblemished male lambs a year old . . . one young bull . . . . . . and two rams They will be a burnt offering to the LORD together with their grain offerings and drink offerings a food offering a pleasing aroma to the LORD

verses.original: וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֛ם אֶחָ֖ד שְׂעִיר־ עִזִּ֥ים לְחַטָּ֑את וּשְׁנֵ֧י כְבָשִׂ֛ים בְּנֵ֥י שָׁנָ֖ה שְׁלָמִֽים׃ לְזֶ֥בַח
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·śî·ṯem ’e·ḥāḏ śə·‘îr- ‘iz·zîm lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ ū·šə·nê ḵə·ḇā·śîm bə·nê šā·nāh šə·lā·mîm lə·ze·ḇaḥ
verses.literal: You shall also prepare one male goat . . . as a sin offering and two male lambs a year old . . . as a peace offering . . .

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵ֣ן׀ וְהֵנִ֣יף אֹתָ֡ם תְּנוּפָה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה עַל֩ לֶ֨חֶם הַבִּכּוּרִ֤ים עַל־ שְׁנֵ֖י כְּבָשִׂ֑ים יִהְי֥וּ קֹ֛דֶשׁ לַיהוָ֖ה לַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên wə·hê·nîp̄ ’ō·ṯām tə·nū·p̄āh lip̄·nê Yah·weh ‘al le·ḥem hab·bik·kū·rîm ‘al- šə·nê kə·ḇā·śîm yih·yū qō·ḏeš Yah·weh lak·kō·hên
verses.literal: The priest is to wave [the lambs] as a wave offering before the LORD together with the bread of the firstfruits - The bread and the two lambs shall be holy to the LORD for the priest

verses.original: הַזֶּ֗ה בְּעֶ֣צֶם׀ הַיּ֣וֹם וּקְרָאתֶ֞ם יִהְיֶ֣ה קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ מִֽקְרָא־ לָכֶ֔ם לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ כָּל־ מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה עוֹלָ֛ם חֻקַּ֥ת בְּכָל־ מוֹשְׁבֹ֥תֵיכֶ֖ם לְדֹרֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: haz·zeh bə·‘e·ṣem hay·yō·wm ū·qə·rā·ṯem yih·yeh qō·ḏeš miq·rā- lā·ḵem lō ṯa·‘ă·śū kāl- mə·le·ḵeṯ ‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh ‘ō·w·lām ḥuq·qaṯ bə·ḵāl mō·wō·šə·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: On that same day you are to proclaim . . . a sacred assembly and you must not do any regular work . . . This is to be a permanent statute wherever you live for the generations to come

verses.original: וּֽבְקֻצְרְכֶ֞ם אֶת־ קְצִ֣יר אַרְצְכֶ֗ם לֹֽא־ בְּקֻצְרֶ֔ךָ תְכַלֶּ֞ה פְּאַ֤ת שָֽׂדְךָ֙ תְלַקֵּ֑ט וְלֶ֥קֶט קְצִירְךָ֖ לֹ֣א תַּעֲזֹ֣ב אֹתָ֔ם לֶֽעָנִ֤י וְלַגֵּר֙ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·quṣ·rə·ḵem ’eṯ- qə·ṣîr ’ar·ṣə·ḵem lō- bə·quṣ·re·ḵā ṯə·ḵal·leh pə·’aṯ śā·ḏə·ḵā ṯə·laq·qêṭ wə·le·qeṭ qə·ṣî·rə·ḵā lō ta·‘ă·zōḇ ’ō·ṯām le·‘ā·nî wə·lag·gêr ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: When you reap - the harvest of your land do not reap all the way to the edges of your field or gather the gleanings of your harvest . . . Leave them for the poor and the foreign resident I am the LORD your God

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: The LORD also said to Moses . . .

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֗דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֜י בַּחֹ֨דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֤ה לָכֶם֙ שַׁבָּת֔וֹן קֹֽדֶשׁ׃ מִקְרָא־ זִכְר֥וֹן תְּרוּעָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr bə·’e·ḥāḏ la·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šə·ḇî·‘î ba·ḥō·ḏeš yih·yeh lā·ḵem šab·bā·ṯō·wn qō·ḏeš miq·rā- ziḵ·rō·wn tə·rū·‘āh
verses.literal: Speak to the Israelites . . . [and] say On the first day of the seventh month you are to have a day of rest a sacred assembly announced by [trumpet] blasts

verses.original: לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ כָּל־ מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֥ם אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō ṯa·‘ă·śū kāl- mə·le·ḵeṯ ‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh wə·hiq·raḇ·tem ’iš·šeh Yah·weh
verses.literal: You must not do any regular work . . . but you are to present a food offering to the LORD

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Again the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: אַ֡ךְ בֶּעָשׂ֣וֹר הַזֶּ֜ה הַשְּׁבִיעִ֨י לַחֹדֶשׁ֩ י֧וֹם הַכִּפֻּרִ֣ים ה֗וּא יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ מִֽקְרָא־ וְעִנִּיתֶ֖ם אֶת־ נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶ֑ם וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֥ם אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ be·‘ā·śō·wr haz·zeh haš·šə·ḇî·‘î la·ḥō·ḏeš yō·wm hak·kip·pu·rîm hū yih·yeh lā·ḵem qō·ḏeš miq·rā- wə·‘in·nî·ṯem ’eṯ- nap̄·šō·ṯê·ḵem wə·hiq·raḇ·tem ’iš·šeh Yah·weh
verses.literal: vvv The tenth day of this seventh month is the Day of Atonement . . . You shall hold a sacred assembly and humble - yourselves and present a food offering to the LORD

verses.original: הַזֶּ֑ה בְּעֶ֖צֶם הַיּ֣וֹם לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ וְכָל־ מְלָאכָה֙ כִּ֣י ה֔וּא י֤וֹם כִּפֻּרִים֙ לְכַפֵּ֣ר עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם לִפְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: haz·zeh bə·‘e·ṣem hay·yō·wm lō ṯa·‘ă·śū wə·ḵāl mə·lā·ḵāh kî hū yō·wm kip·pu·rîm lə·ḵap·pêr ‘ă·lê·ḵem lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: On this . . . day you are not to do any work for it is the Day of Atonement when atonement is made for you before the LORD your God

verses.original: כִּ֤י כָל־ הַנֶּ֙פֶשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ תְעֻנֶּ֔ה הַזֶּ֑ה בְּעֶ֖צֶם הַיּ֣וֹם וְנִכְרְתָ֖ה מֵֽעַמֶּֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵāl han·ne·p̄eš ’ă·šer lō- ṯə·‘un·neh haz·zeh bə·‘e·ṣem hay·yō·wm wə·niḵ·rə·ṯāh mê·‘am·me·hā
verses.literal: If anyone . . . - does not humble himself on this . . . day he must be cut off from his people

verses.original: וְהַֽאֲבַדְתִּ֛י אֶת־ הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽהּ׃ וְכָל־ הַנֶּ֗פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר תַּעֲשֶׂה֙ כָּל־ מְלָאכָ֔ה הַזֶּ֑ה בְּעֶ֖צֶם הַיּ֣וֹם
verses.transliteration: wə·ha·’ă·ḇaḏ·tî ’eṯ- han·ne·p̄eš ha·hi·w miq·qe·reḇ ‘am·māh wə·ḵāl han·ne·p̄eš ’ă·šer ta·‘ă·śeh kāl- mə·lā·ḵāh haz·zeh bə·‘e·ṣem hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: I will destroy - - . . . from among his people anyone . . . who does any work on this . . . day

verses.original: לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ כָּל־ מְלָאכָ֖ה עוֹלָם֙ חֻקַּ֤ת לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם בְּכֹ֖ל מֹֽשְׁבֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lō ṯa·‘ă·śū kāl- mə·lā·ḵāh ‘ō·w·lām ḥuq·qaṯ lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem bə·ḵōl mō·šə·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: You are not to do any work {at all} This is a permanent statute for the generations to come wherever you live

verses.original: הוּא֙ שַׁבַּ֨ת שַׁבָּת֥וֹן לָכֶ֔ם וְעִנִּיתֶ֖ם אֶת־ נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶ֑ם בָּעֶ֔רֶב בְּתִשְׁעָ֤ה לַחֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ עַד־ עֶ֔רֶב מֵעֶ֣רֶב תִּשְׁבְּת֖וּ שַׁבַּתְּכֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: hū šab·baṯ šab·bā·ṯō·wn lā·ḵem wə·‘in·nî·ṯem ’eṯ- nap̄·šō·ṯê·ḵem bā·‘e·reḇ bə·ṯiš·‘āh la·ḥō·ḏeš ‘aḏ- ‘e·reḇ mê·‘e·reḇ tiš·bə·ṯū šab·bat·tə·ḵem
verses.literal: It will be a Sabbath of complete rest for you and you shall humble - yourselves From the evening of the ninth day of the month until . . . the following evening you are to keep your Sabbath

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֜ר י֗וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה הַשְּׁבִיעִי֙ לַחֹ֤דֶשׁ חַ֧ג הַסֻּכּ֛וֹת לַיהֹוָֽה׃ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr ba·ḥă·miš·šāh ‘ā·śār yō·wm haz·zeh haš·šə·ḇî·‘î la·ḥō·ḏeš ḥaḡ has·suk·kō·wṯ Yah·weh šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm
verses.literal: Speak to the Israelites . . . [and] say On the fifteenth . . . day of the seventh month the Feast of Tabernacles to the LORD [begins] and it continues for seven days

verses.original: הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן בַּיּ֥וֹם קֹ֑דֶשׁ מִקְרָא־ לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃ כָּל־ מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: hā·ri·šō·wn bay·yō·wm qō·ḏeš miq·rā- lō ṯa·‘ă·śū kāl- mə·le·ḵeṯ ‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh
verses.literal: On the first day [there shall be] a sacred assembly You must not do any regular work . . .

verses.original: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים תַּקְרִ֥יבוּ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָ֑ה הַשְּׁמִינִ֡י בַּיּ֣וֹם יִהְיֶ֨ה לָכֶ֜ם קֹדֶשׁ֩ מִקְרָא־ וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם אִשֶּׁ֤ה לַֽיהוָה֙ הִ֔וא עֲצֶ֣רֶת לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃ כָּל־ מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm taq·rî·ḇū ’iš·šeh Yah·weh haš·šə·mî·nî bay·yō·wm yih·yeh lā·ḵem qō·ḏeš miq·rā- wə·hiq·raḇ·tem ’iš·šeh Yah·weh hî ‘ă·ṣe·reṯ lō ṯa·‘ă·śū kāl- mə·le·ḵeṯ ‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh
verses.literal: For seven days you are to present a food offering to the LORD On the eighth day you are to hold a sacred assembly and present a food offering to the LORD It [is] a solemn assembly you must not do any regular work . . .

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה יְהוָ֔ה מוֹעֲדֵ֣י אֲשֶׁר־ תִּקְרְא֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם קֹ֑דֶשׁ מִקְרָאֵ֣י לְהַקְרִ֨יב אִשֶּׁ֜ה לַיהוָ֗ה עֹלָ֧ה וּמִנְחָ֛ה זֶ֥בַח וּנְסָכִ֖ים דְּבַר־ י֥וֹם בְּיוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh Yah·weh mō·w·‘ă·ḏê ’ă·šer- tiq·rə·’ū ’ō·ṯām qō·ḏeš miq·rā·’ê lə·haq·rîḇ ’iš·šeh Yah·weh ‘ō·lāh ū·min·ḥāh ze·ḇaḥ ū·nə·sā·ḵîm də·ḇar- yō·wm bə·yō·w·mōw
verses.literal: These are the LORD’s appointed feasts which you are to proclaim - as sacred assemblies for presenting food offerings to the LORD burnt offerings and grain offerings sacrifices and drink offerings each on its designated day

verses.original: מִלְּבַ֖ד יְּהוָ֑ה וּמִלְּבַ֣ד שַׁבְּתֹ֣ת מַתְּנֽוֹתֵיכֶ֗ם וּמִלְּבַ֤ד כָּל־ נִדְרֵיכֶם֙ וּמִלְּבַד֙ כָּל־ נִדְב֣וֹתֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּתְּנ֖וּ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mil·lə·ḇaḏ Yah·weh ū·mil·lə·ḇaḏ šab·bə·ṯōṯ mat·tə·nō·w·ṯê·ḵem ū·mil·lə·ḇaḏ kāl- niḏ·rê·ḵem ū·mil·lə·ḇaḏ kāl- niḏ·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem ’ă·šer tit·tə·nū Yah·weh
verses.literal: [These offerings are] in addition to the offerings for the LORD’s . . . Sabbaths [and in addition] to your gifts . . . to all your vow offerings . . . and to all the freewill offerings - you give to the LORD

verses.original: אַ֡ךְ בַּחֲמִשָּׁה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר י֜וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ בְּאָסְפְּכֶם֙ אֶת־ תְּבוּאַ֣ת הָאָ֔רֶץ תָּחֹ֥גּוּ אֶת־ חַג־ יְהוָ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים שַׁבָּת֔וֹן הָֽרִאשׁוֹן֙ בַּיּ֤וֹם שַׁבָּתֽוֹן׃ הַשְּׁמִינִ֖י וּבַיּ֥וֹם
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ ba·ḥă·miš·šāh ‘ā·śār yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î la·ḥō·ḏeš bə·’ā·sə·pə·ḵem ’eṯ- tə·ḇū·’aṯ hā·’ā·reṣ tā·ḥōg·gū ’eṯ- ḥaḡ- Yah·weh šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm šab·bā·ṯō·wn hā·ri·šō·wn bay·yō·wm šab·bā·ṯō·wn haš·šə·mî·nî ū·ḇay·yō·wm
verses.literal: - On the fifteenth . . . day of the seventh month after you have gathered - the produce of the land you are to celebrate - a feast to the LORD for seven days There shall be complete rest on the first day and [also] on the eighth day

verses.original: הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן בַּיּ֣וֹם וּלְקַחְתֶּ֨ם לָכֶ֜ם פְּרִ֨י הָדָר֙ עֵ֤ץ כַּפֹּ֣ת תְּמָרִ֔ים וַעֲנַ֥ף עָבֹ֖ת עֵץ־ וְעַרְבֵי־ נָ֑חַל וּשְׂמַחְתֶּ֗ם לִפְנֵ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hā·ri·šō·wn bay·yō·wm ū·lə·qaḥ·tem lā·ḵem pə·rî hā·ḏār ‘êṣ kap·pōṯ tə·mā·rîm wa·‘ă·nap̄ ‘ā·ḇōṯ ‘êṣ- wə·‘ar·ḇê- nā·ḥal ū·śə·maḥ·tem lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm
verses.literal: On the first day you are to gather the fruit of majestic trees the branches of palm trees and the boughs of leafy trees and of willows of the brook And you are to rejoice before the LORD your God for seven days

verses.original: וְחַגֹּתֶ֤ם אֹתוֹ֙ חַ֣ג לַֽיהוָ֔ה שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים בַּשָּׁנָ֑ה עוֹלָם֙ חֻקַּ֤ת לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם תָּחֹ֥גּוּ אֹתֽוֹ׃ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י בַּחֹ֥דֶשׁ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥag·gō·ṯem ’ō·ṯōw ḥaḡ Yah·weh šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm baš·šā·nāh ‘ō·w·lām ḥuq·qaṯ lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem tā·ḥōg·gū ’ō·ṯōw haš·šə·ḇî·‘î ba·ḥō·ḏeš
verses.literal: You are to celebrate this as a feast to the LORD for seven days each year This is a permanent statute for the generations to come you are to celebrate it in the seventh month

verses.original: תֵּשְׁב֖וּ בַּסֻּכֹּ֥ת שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים כָּל־ הָֽאֶזְרָח֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יֵשְׁב֖וּ בַּסֻּכֹּֽת׃
verses.transliteration: tê·šə·ḇū bas·suk·kōṯ šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm kāl- hā·’ez·rāḥ bə·yiś·rā·’êl yê·šə·ḇū bas·suk·kōṯ
verses.literal: You are to dwell in booths for seven days All the native-born of Israel must dwell in booths

verses.original: לְמַעַן֮ דֹרֹֽתֵיכֶם֒ יֵדְע֣וּ כִּ֣י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הוֹשַׁ֙בְתִּי֙ אֶת־ בַסֻּכּ֗וֹת בְּהוֹצִיאִ֥י אוֹתָ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem yê·ḏə·‘ū kî bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl hō·wō·šaḇ·tî ’eṯ- ḇas·suk·kō·wṯ bə·hō·w·ṣî·’î ’ō·w·ṯām mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: so that your descendants may know that I made the Israelites . . . dwell - in booths when I brought them out - of the land of Egypt I am the LORD your God

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶת־ וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ מֹעֲדֵ֖י יְהוָ֑ה
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh ’eṯ- way·ḏab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl mō·‘ă·ḏê Yah·weh
verses.literal: So Moses - announced to the Israelites . . . the appointed [feasts] of the LORD
